chain.title: Keep the engineer's plans nearby
chain.desc: Craft the Engineer's Manual from a book and lever. Use its rotating multiblock diagrams to check materials, orientation, and the exact block to strike with the hammer.

chain.title: The tool that forms a factory
chain.desc: Craft an Engineer's Hammer for plates, configuration, and forming multiblocks. Carry the manual alongside it when starting a new machine.

chain.title: Bricks for the first oven
chain.desc: Craft enough Coke Bricks for the manual's 3 by 3 by 3 oven. Keep access to the formed machine so you can remove coal coke and collect its creosote.

chain.title: Assemble a Coke Oven
chain.desc: Build the complete Coke Oven and form it with the Engineer's Hammer. Run one coal batch and provide somewhere for the creosote to go. Confirm this milestone yourself when the oven works.

chain.title: Fuel for the steelworks
chain.desc: Collect coal coke from the Coke Oven. Creosote can fill the fluid buffer and stop processing, so make draining it part of the workshop routine.

chain.title: Make use of the creosote
chain.desc: Combine creosote with planks to make treated wood. It supplies workbenches, structural parts, and early power equipment while keeping the coke oven moving.

chain.title: Bricks for a hotter furnace
chain.desc: Gather the Nether materials for Blast Bricks and prepare the manual's furnace layout. This is a separate project from the renewable-power branch.

chain.title: Assemble a Crude Blast Furnace
chain.desc: Build and form the furnace from Blast Bricks. Supply iron and an accepted blast-furnace fuel, then confirm this step after it produces steel.

chain.title: The first steel batch
chain.desc: Collect steel from the Blast Furnace. Reserve it for useful components and machines before spending a large batch on structural decoration.

chain.title: Turn rotation into power
chain.desc: Place a Kinetic Dynamo and connect a compatible windmill or waterwheel. The attached rotating device provides the energy; the dynamo does not run on its own.

chain.title: Power above the workshop
chain.desc: Attach a Windmill to the dynamo in an open location. Route the resulting power to a nearby machine or buffer and verify the connection before extending the wire run.

chain.title: Wire the first circuit
chain.desc: Craft LV Wire Coils for short power connections. Use the correct connectors, observe the wire's limits, and plan the route so exposed wires do not cross busy walkways.

chain.title: Connect power to a machine
chain.desc: Mount LV connectors on the relevant machine faces and link them with copper wire. Add relays for corners; relays and connectors have different jobs.

chain.title: Work from blueprints
chain.desc: Set up an Engineer's Workbench and use the appropriate blueprint or tool interface. Components, equipment upgrades, and molds give this station several useful jobs.

chain.title: A medium-voltage branch
chain.desc: Make electrum wire for the MV network and use matching connectors. Upgrade a circuit deliberately; changing the wire alone does not change the attached device's limits.

chain.title: Components for working machines
chain.desc: Craft Light Engineering Blocks for early multiblocks. Consult the chosen machine's materials list rather than treating this block as a complete machine.

chain.title: Components for heavy machinery
chain.desc: Craft Heavy Engineering Blocks as required by the larger multiblocks. Start with a machine that solves a real materials or energy bottleneck.

chain.title: A mold for repeatable plates
chain.desc: Create the plate mold using the Engineer's Workbench. Metal Press recipes depend on the installed mold, so keep separate molds for the shapes you need.

chain.title: Assemble and test a Metal Press
chain.desc: Build the manual's Metal Press, form it with the hammer, install a mold, and supply power. Feed a test ingot across the conveyor and confirm when a plate comes out.

chain.title: Assemble and test a Crusher
chain.desc: Build the Crusher from the manual's materials list and connect appropriate power. Test a supported input and provide output storage; confirm when the processing path works.

chain.title: Ferment a fuel ingredient
chain.desc: Build and power the Fermenter, then supply a supported crop to produce ethanol. Connect a tank or pipe to its fluid output and confirm after collecting the first batch.

chain.title: Press a supply of plant oil
chain.desc: Build and power the Squeezer. Feed a supported seed to produce plant oil, then route the output toward storage or the future refinery. Confirm after the first useful batch.

chain.title: Blend your first biodiesel
chain.desc: Assemble and power the Refinery, supply ethanol and plant oil to the correct inputs, and collect biodiesel. Confirm when both ingredient lines feed a working fuel recipe.

chain.title: Equip the fuel-powered drill
chain.desc: Build the Mining Drill, fit a suitable drill head, and fill it with an accepted fuel. Biodiesel is one option; this tool need not wait for every heavy machine in the chapter.

chain.title: Run a Diesel Generator
chain.desc: Construct the generator using the manual and connect biodiesel and a suitable power output. Confirm after it runs under load, with fuel supply and output capacity both working.

chain.title: An HV route for big consumers
chain.desc: Craft HV wire and use matching connectors and relays. Keep the route clear and respect voltage conversion when connecting lower-voltage branches.

chain.title: Prepare consumable electrodes
chain.desc: Follow the installed graphite and electrode recipes. The Arc Furnace consumes electrodes during operation, so arrange replacements before treating it as an unattended production line.

chain.title: Bring the Arc Furnace online
chain.desc: Build the Arc Furnace, insert graphite electrodes, and supply power and a valid recipe. Confirm after it produces a useful alloy or recycled metal; diesel generation is only one possible power source.

chain.title: Survey before you excavate
chain.desc: Power a Core Sample Drill and inspect the resulting sample. Look for a useful mineral vein before choosing the location of the Excavator.

chain.title: Excavate a surveyed mineral vein
chain.desc: Build both the Excavator and its bucket wheel over a surveyed vein. Connect power and output storage, then confirm when the wheel delivers resources. Veins have limits; inspect the core sample.

notes: Re-reviewed against cached Immersive Engineering 10.2.0-183 for Minecraft 1.20.1. Removed formed-machine item objectives; component acquisition and honest manual assembly confirmations replace them. Models, registry labels, selected recipes, and the bundled manual ground this guide. The old blanket claim that formed block items were obtainable is superseded.

coverage.scope: Authored branched progression; item and component acquisition objectives, not automatic proof that a factory works.
limits: Formed multiblock blocks are not normal inventory targets; assembly milestones use explicit player-confirmed checkmarks with obtainable component icons.
The manual remains authoritative for complete material counts and layouts.
Pack scripts, recipe changes, and other Minecraft versions require the installed-pack scan; this guide is not a complete mod manual.
coverage.verification: Local JAR item models and English registry names; selected recipes and bundled manuals checked. Not a new in-game playthrough.
